description: A squat figure of dark wood, arms folded, eyes shut, rubbed to a shine. They come up out of the grass by the dozen.
lore: The trade calls them idols because it needs a word. Nobody has produced a name for the figure, a rite it belonged to, or one person who ever knelt to one, and that is not for want of asking — they come up in the grass by the dozen where [[monsters/rune_lion|Runemane]] walks its round, and the only plan of the building is a sheet of [[characters/a6d7323d|Gunnar]]'s with nothing to write at the top of it.

They brought one to [[characters/cfe826c1|Jehanne]], on the reasonable grounds that she is the nearest thing to an expert this road has. She turned it over twice — the shine on them is thumbs, and there are a very great many thumbs in that shine — said she had never seen the like, gave it back, and went out to keep her evening rota. She kept the second one. It sits on the shelf over her table, arms folded, eyes shut, seventy gold any day she wanted seventy gold, and she has stopped explaining to people why it is there.
gm_notes: A religious object with no religion attached, and it stays that way — no pantheon. Jehanne keeping one is the whole point: she practises a faith she does not believe, and here is an object in the same condition.
